material_identity: Arlabosse2005 characterized unincinerated activated sludge, industrial85%/municipal15% wastewater feed, flotation/centrifugation; not MIA3; same aliquot unknown

assets.license: publisher CC BY-NC4.0 per existing source record; original retained privately

design_domain.rationale: Nonreacting fixed-pressure conditional domain within dry-Cp source interval and readable curve hull; not a measured wet-property validity interval

construction.activity: piecewise linear ln(aw) over reviewed activity nodes in the domain
construction.heat: piecewise linear nominal q_total over its six readable nodes; missing observed q at .5 and .6 remains unknown
construction.reference: m0=Rs*T0*ln(aw0); b0=(h_v_ideal(T0)-h_l(T0,P))-q0; integrate m0,b0 from W*=.8 to get Gex0,Hex0
construction.desorption_heat: q(T,W)=h_v_ideal(T)-h_liquid(T,P)-b0(W), J/kg removed water; already includes vaporization
construction.water_bridge: Existing WaterChemicalPotential real liquid plus ideal vapor; same molar mass, energy/entropy reference and fixed mixture R. aw is relative to this model pure-water equilibrium pressure, not certified native psat
construction.numerical_policy: Finite binary64 point calculations; inversion has explicit numerical tolerances, not experimental uncertainty

exclusions: material validation or full firing cycle
